title: Renovations
summary: Kitchens, bathrooms and whole-house makeovers, finished on time and to a high standard.
intro: Breathe new life into your home. From a single room to a full makeover, we manage every trade so you don't have to.
body:
## What we renovate

- **Kitchens**: strip-out, layout changes, fitting and finishing
- **Bathrooms and wet rooms**: full refits including tiling and plumbing coordination
- **Whole-house refurbishments**: rewiring, replastering, flooring and decoration
- **Knock-throughs**: opening up rooms with proper structural support

We plan the work so you can live with as little disruption as possible, and keep the site clean and safe throughout.
features: Project managed from start to finish
